reason: My buyers have never once asked to see a home before it's built; they look at the architect's plans and my photos of finished homes. I'm doing 1-6 homes a year, so this is not something I'm short of.
objection: Will it actually match the plans? If it shows something we won't build, I've got a homeowner who expects the render and a cost-plus argument on my hands.
would_change_my_mind: A client asking me for it on a job, or seeing it run on one of my own plans and matching it exactly, including finishes I'd really spec.
